ru.wb.confirmValidate: Отметить {n} детекций в {m} вылетах как проверенные человеком? Подтверждение запишется на каждую из них, включая те, которые никто не смотрел, и отменить это здесь нельзя.
ru.wb.noMapPosition: {n} животных без положения на карте — в этой сборке их не проверить
ru.wb.noMapPositionWhy: В архиве есть запись по каждому из этих животных — с координатами в пикселях и баллом, но без широты и долготы; их вылет — видео, поэтому единого кадра для проверки нет. Проверка по кадрам видео появится позже.
ru.rev.startWhy: Пройти по каждой точке на кадре, начиная с самого низкого балла, и вынести решение.
ru.rev.legend: V — проверено · X — ложное · пробел — пропустить · ← → — переход · Esc — выход
ru.rev.noRecord: У этой точки нет отдельной записи в архиве, поэтому решение по ней сохранить нельзя.
ru.rev.endOfPass: Конец прохода — все точки на кадре пройдены.
ru.rev.walkAll: Все точки на этом кадре, включая отклонённые.
ru.rec.notes.title: Полевые заметки
ru.rec.notes.placeholder: Что было в поле: погода, беспокойство, всё, чего не скажет подсчёт.
ru.rec.notes.noSurvey: У этого вылета нет записи в сервисе, поэтому заметку сохранить некуда.
ru.rec.site.label: Участок
ru.rec.site.applies: Название получат все {n} вылета в пределах 2 км от этого места.
ru.rec.site.reuse: Будет использован существующий участок «{name}» в пределах 2 км.
ru.rec.site.noSurvey: У этого вылета нет записи в сервисе, поэтому привязать его к участку нельзя.
ru.rec.date.notRecorded: дата съёмки не записана — показано время подсчёта
ru.rec.meta.noticeArea: Площадь охвата пересчитается по новому масштабу.
ru.rec.meta.noticeCount: Число тюленей не изменится: чтобы пересчитать его, нужен повторный прогон движка.
ru.rec.meta.noticeAlt: Даже если менять только высоту, масштаб выводится заново — площадь сдвинется вместе с ним.
ru.rec.meta.noticeDate: Смена даты сдвигает вылет на шкале времени и может изменить, какой визит берётся в текущую оценку по этому участку.
ru.rec.meta.futureDate: Дата не может быть в будущем
ru.rec.meta.noSurvey: У этого вылета нет записи в сервисе, поэтому метаданные править негде.
ru.rec.edits.title: Журнал правок
ru.rec.edits.noRun: У этого вылета нет прогона в сервисе, значит нет и журнала.
ru.rec.retire.title: Вывести вылет из учёта
ru.rec.retire.explain: Вылет остаётся в архиве, но перестаёт входить в оценку.
ru.rec.retire.failed: Не удалось вывести вылет из учёта
ru.rec.retire.undoFailed: Не удалось вернуть вылет в учёт
ru.rec.retire.localOnly: Этот вылет в сервис не отправлялся, поэтому вывод из учёта просто забудет его здесь.
ru.rec.manual.title: Наземный учёт
ru.rec.manual.lead: Счёт человека, а не движка. Он везде помечен как «вручную» и не имеет диапазона.
ru.rec.manual.pinHint: Кликните карту там, где проводился наземный учёт.
ru.rec.manual.badCount: Количество — целое число, ноль или больше
ru.rec.manual.futureDate: Дата не может быть в будущем
ru.rec.manual.noBand: У счёта человека нет диапазона — один взгляд, одно число.
ru.rec.operator.title: Ваше имя сохраняется вместе с решениями, заметками и наземными учётами.
ru.rec.left.emptyUpload: 1 · Загрузите фото или видео залёжки — движок посчитает и даст диапазон, а не одно число.
ru.rec.left.emptyReview: 2 · Проверьте найденное — каждое решение сохраняется с именем того, кто его принял.
ru.rec.left.emptyReport: 3 · Выгрузите сезон в GeoJSON, CSV или PDF-отчёт.
ru.rec.left.emptyManual: Нет съёмки с дрона? Запишите наземный учёт вручную.

en.left.emptyHint: Drop an MP4 with a matching .SRT or .JSON track to ingest a sortie. Without GPS, pin the flight path on the map instead.
en.insp.selectHint: Select a sortie on the map or in the footage list to inspect its count and track.
en.dash.noSorties: No sorties in the selected window.
en.dash.notesEmpty: Widen the timeline or ingest footage to populate analytics.
en.drop.title: Drop footage, or click to browse
en.drop.sub: MP4 with a matching .SRT or .JSON track — or a bare MP4 with embedded GPS
en.drop.sampleAria: Use the sample clip — 38 second drone video with GPS in its metadata
en.drop.sampleDesc: 38s drone video, GPS in metadata · Tyuleniy West
en.drop.sampleError: Could not load the sample clip ({msg}). It ships at public{url} — check it wasn't removed.
en.drop.pendingHint: No location — click the map once, at the centre of the shot; the animals are then laid out around that point by their true positions in the frame.
en.drop.pinInstruction: Click the map once — where the centre of the shot was — then confirm.
en.drop.srtError: Could not read the SRT for {base}: {msg}
en.drop.jsonError: Could not read the JSON sidecar: {msg}
en.drop.photoPinned: photo · location pinned on the map
en.drop.imageNoLocation: {name}: no location — click the map once at the centre of the shot, then press Confirm.
en.drop.pinnedCentre: location pinned · centre of the shot
en.drop.gpsOutside: {name}: GPS found at {lat}, {lng} — outside the Caspian survey area, so it can't be plotted. Pin the path on the map to place it manually.
en.drop.noGps: No GPS found in {name}. Pin the flight path on the map, then confirm.
en.drop.readError: Could not read {name}: {msg}. Pin the path manually instead.
en.drop.skipped: Skipped {base} — needs a video plus .srt/.json, or a pinned path.
en.drop.trackOnlyError: no video or photo in this drop — the track was drawn but nothing could be counted
en.ev.loadFailed: The source frame could not be loaded. The count and its points are unaffected — only this preview is missing.
en.ev.title: Evidence
en.ev.hint: scroll to zoom · drag to pan · double-click to reset
en.map.anchorSet: Anchor set — click again to move it, then Confirm
en.map.clickCentre: Click the map at the centre of the shot
en.page.emptyBody: SEALv reads the flight track from the video, counts seals, and plots the count where the footage was shot.
en.dash.repeatBasis: latest sortie against the one before it; sorties whose centres are within {km} km count as one site
en.dash.repeatNone: One survey per site — nothing to compare yet.
en.dash.noPlaced: No points with coordinates in this window.
en.dash.notesArea: Surveyed area ≈ {a} ha — a sum of frame footprints, overlap not deduplicated.
en.dash.notesNoArea: Surveyed area is unknown: no sortie carries a GSD.
en.rep.title: Seal survey report
en.rep.areaNote: Area is the sum of frame footprints; overlap is not deduplicated.
en.rep.method: CountGD detection. The range is the disagreement between frames; the basis is stated for each sortie. Verified = validated ÷ (validated + auto). False positives are excluded from every figure.
en.dash.assumedGsd: {n} sortie(s) rest on an assumed scale, not a measured one
en.dash.aggregateOnly: {n} sortie(s) contributed only an aggregate marker — those animals have no individual coordinates.
en.rep.totalNote: Sum over sorties: an animal seen on two sorties is counted twice.
en.dash.nothingToVerify: Nothing to review yet — no point has been verified or rejected.
en.est.basis: The current estimate keeps only the latest sortie at each site (centres within {km} km are one site), so a repeat survey or a re-upload is not added on top.
en.est.restoringBody: Reading the surveys already held in the archive.
en.est.unreachable: The archive could not be reached
en.est.unreachableBody: Surveys already saved could not be loaded. That is a connection failure, not an empty database.
en.dash.exportFail: The report could not be built
en.insp.bandUnusableWhy: The best estimate falls outside its own low–high range, so no marker is drawn. See the caveats.
en.wb.confirmFalse: Mark {n} detections as false positives? They leave every count and export until you undo this.
en.wb.noScore: The model did not score this detection
en.wb.kept: Kept in the list after your verdict, so you can still undo it
en.wb.selectAll: Select every detection in this list
en.drop.busy: Still ingesting the previous drop — wait for it to finish.
en.drop.offWater: {n} of {total} track points fall outside the mapped water area — left as measured
en.drop.gpsOverridesPin: used the video's own GPS, the map pin was ignored
en.drop.evenSpacing: positions measured, times spread evenly — the file carries no timestamps
en.drop.srtNoPoints: no GPS points found in the SRT
en.drop.srtOutsideBasin: only {inside}/{total} points inside the Caspian basin (35–49N, 45–56E) — check lat/lng order
en.store.archiveUnreadable: The archive could not be read
en.wb.unsaved: This verdict did not save to the archive
en.wb.markVerifiedWhy: Writes a human confirmation of this detection into the archive. There is no way back to "not reviewed".
en.wb.markFalseWhy: Writes a rejection into the archive. The animal leaves every count and export until it is marked verified again.
en.wb.confirmValidate: Mark {n} detections across {m} sorties as human-verified? The confirmation is written on every one of them, including the ones nobody has looked at, and it cannot be undone here.
en.wb.noMapPosition: {n} animals with no map position — not reviewable in this build
en.wb.noMapPositionWhy: The archive holds a record for each of these animals, with pixel coordinates and a score, but no latitude and longitude; their sortie is a video, so there is no single frame to review them on. Review of video frames comes later.
en.rev.startWhy: Walk every point on this frame, lowest score first, and rule on it.
en.rev.legend: V verify · X false · Space skip · ← → move · Esc exit
en.rev.noRecord: This point has no per-animal record in the archive, so a verdict cannot be saved for it.
en.rev.endOfPass: End of the pass — every point on this frame has been visited.
en.rev.panOff: the walk drives the frame · panning is off
en.rev.walkAll: Every point on this frame, rejected ones included.
en.rec.notes.title: Field notes
en.rec.notes.placeholder: What the flight saw: conditions, disturbance, anything the count cannot say.
en.rec.notes.tooLong: A note must be at most {max} characters
en.rec.notes.noSurvey: This sortie has no survey record in the service, so a note has nowhere to save.
en.rec.site.label: Site
en.rec.site.applies: The name is given to all {n} sorties within 2 km of this place.
en.rec.site.reuse: Uses the existing site “{name}” within 2 km.
en.rec.site.failed: The site could not be saved
en.rec.site.noSurvey: This sortie has no survey record, so it cannot be attached to a site.
en.rec.date.notRecorded: date not recorded — showing when the count ran
en.rec.meta.noticeArea: The photographed area is recomputed from the new scale.
en.rec.meta.noticeCount: The count does not change: re-deriving it needs another run of the engine.
en.rec.meta.noticeAlt: Altitude alone re-derives the scale, so the area moves with it.
en.rec.meta.noticeDate: Changing the date moves the sortie on the timeline and may change which visit the current estimate uses for this place.
en.rec.meta.badNumber: The number must be greater than zero
en.rec.meta.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future
en.rec.meta.noSurvey: This sortie has no survey record, so there is no metadata to correct.
en.rec.edits.title: Correction log
en.rec.edits.failed: The log could not be read
en.rec.edits.noRun: This sortie has no service run, so it has no log.
en.rec.retire.title: Retire this sortie
en.rec.retire.explain: The sortie stays in the archive and stops counting toward the estimate.
en.rec.retire.failed: The sortie could not be retired
en.rec.retire.undoFailed: The sortie could not be brought back
en.rec.retire.localOnly: This sortie was never sent to the service, so retiring it only forgets it here.
en.rec.manual.title: Ground count
en.rec.manual.lead: A count made by a person, not the engine. It is labelled manual everywhere and carries no range.
en.rec.manual.pinHint: Click the map where the ground count was made.
en.rec.manual.methodPlaceholder: e.g. from a boat, with binoculars
en.rec.manual.failed: The ground count could not be recorded
en.rec.manual.badCount: The count must be a whole number, zero or more
en.rec.manual.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future
en.rec.manual.noBand: A person's count has no range — one look, one number.
en.rec.operator.title: Your name is stored with your verdicts, notes and ground counts.
en.rec.left.emptyUpload: 1 · Upload a photo or video of a haul-out. The engine counts it and gives a range, not a single number.
en.rec.left.emptyReview: 2 · Review what it found. Every verdict is saved with the name of whoever made it.
en.rec.left.emptyReport: 3 · Export the season as GeoJSON, CSV, or a PDF report.
en.rec.left.emptyManual: No drone footage? Record a ground count by hand.
